note: Adapted from the description of Roonwal and Sen-Sarma (1960) as reproduced by Chhotani (1997); the original is in English; soldier, worker and alate are all treated, the worker being dimorphic; the alate description is based on material collected in a different series from the soldier and worker; the number of antennal segments is not recorded because the original is incomplete; the synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier frontal projection conspicuous, rounded and nodular; fontanelle situated below the frontal projection, with a sclerotized ring; mandibles long and sword-shaped, each with a distinct medially placed tooth directed slightly backward; pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin usually without a notch. Alate fontanelle plate conspicuous, small and narrow. Worker dimorphic.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule dark straw yellow, smoky brown around the frontal projection; antennae paler; mandibles dark reddish brown; pronotum, legs and body creamy white. Head and body densely hairy. Body length 3.0–4.0 mm. Head capsule subrectangular to oval, rather thick; head length to mandibular base 0.85–0.90 mm, maximum width 0.75–0.80 mm, height 0.65–0.70 mm; width slightly less than length, ratio of width to head length 0.83–0.89. Frontal projection conspicuous, rounded and nodular; frons steeply sloping anteriorly. Fontanelle situated below the frontal projection, conspicuous, with a sclerotized ring; distance from the occiput to the fontanelle 0.80 mm; fontanelle gland large. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2 and subequal to or slightly longer than segment 4. Labrum tongue-shaped, narrowed anteriorly; length 0.10–0.13 mm, width 0.15–0.175 mm. Mandibles long, sword-shaped, apex strongly incurved, outer margin incurved medially; length slightly less than head length (0.80–0.85 mm), ratio of mandible length to head length 0.89–0.98; each mandible with a sharp and distinct tooth situated medially and directed slightly backward. Gula subrectangular, posterior part with a weakly incurved waist; length 0.45 mm, maximum width 0.25 mm, waist width 0.15 mm; distinctly arched in lateral view. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin usually without a notch, sometimes with a weak notch; posterior margin straight; length 0.20–0.25 mm, width 0.40–0.45 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule pale yellow to pale straw yellow; pronotum and antennae paler; legs and body yellowish white. Head and body densely hairy. Body length about 3.0–3.5 mm. Head capsule subsquare; head length to mandibular base 0.60–0.65 mm, maximum width 0.70–0.75 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 3 and 4 subequal, both shorter than segment 2. Postclypeus convex, about half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.25 mm, width 0.45 mm; anterior margin with a weak median notch. Minor worker: resembling the major worker but smaller; body length 2.4–2.7 mm, head length to mandibular base 0.55–0.60 mm, maximum head width 0.65–0.70 mm, pronotum width 0.40–0.45 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule and thorax dark smoky brown; postclypeus straw yellow; abdominal tergites and legs slightly paler than the head. Head and body rather hairy. Head capsule subcircular; head length to mandibular base 0.65 mm, maximum width including eyes 0.75 mm. Fontanelle plate conspicuous, small and narrow, semitransparent, situated slightly behind the middle. Compound eyes subcircular, close to the antennae; maximum diameter 0.20 mm, distance between eye and antenna 0.05 mm. Ocelli oval, length 0.075 mm; distance from the compound eye slightly less than their length (0.05–0.063 mm). Antennae incomplete, number of segments unknown. Postclypeus convex and hairy, about half as long as wide. Labrum subsquare, length 0.20 mm, nearly equal to the width (0.20–0.25 mm). Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum flat, subrectangular; length 0.35 mm, maximum width 0.55–0.60 mm; anterior margin nearly straight, with a very weak median concavity.
